item.title: Zelenskyy speaks with NPR; Pope Leo diagnosed with lung cancer
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy gave a sit-down interview to NPR as Russia's full-scale invasion nears the five-year mark. Pope Leo XIV has been diagnosed with lung cancer.

item.title: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigns as U.S. ambassador to Greece amid misconduct allegations
item.description: The White House publicly requested the resignation of U.S. Ambassador to Greece Kimberly Guilfoyle on Tuesday as she faced mounting accusations of improper conduct.

item.title: Workers train robots that may replace them
item.description: Factory workers in India are wearing GoPro cameras to record their job tasks. The goal is to train robots to take over their roles.

item.title: September inflation rises, Social Security benefits to increase
item.description: Consumer prices rose 3.7% year-over-year in September. The Social Security Administration announced benefits will increase next year to keep pace.
